description:

66666% Dark DMG (Physical).
Increases DMG by 66% & CRI DMG by 99% for both units for 99s .

100000% Fire & Earth DMG (Physical).

77000% Light DMG (Magic).

150000% Water (Magic) & Light (Physical) DMG.

Adds 150000% to Cross Arts DMG scaling factor
when "Testament of the King" and "Overlord's squire" are MAX.

100000% Dark DMG (Physical).
Increases Arts gauge by 100 for both units.

Auto-fills Luahn's Arts gauge by 6, also increases Skill CT speed & ATK by 100% for 120s.
